# pbs_user (Data Source)

Reads a single user from Proxmox Backup Server. Fails if the user does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a single user
data "pbs_user" "backup" {
  userid = "backup@pbs"
}

output "backup_user_enabled" {
  value = data.pbs_user.backup.enable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) User ID in the form `name@realm` (e.g. `backup@pbs`).

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled.
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration as Unix epoch seconds (`0` = never).
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
